notes: Digital half-rack (1/2 RU) wireless IEM/monitor transmitter, not a microphone transmitter — "Wireless mic" was chosen as the closest available type in the fixed enum since no "Wireless IEM" option exists. Two BNC antenna outputs, two Dante RJ45 ports, and one separate control Ethernet RJ45 are confirmed from Lectrosonics' official M2T Technical Data sheet (24 May 2024) rear-panel photo and spec table. Power input has no explicit connector-type spec line — a DC-polarity glyph plus "9-18 VDC, 2A max" silkscreen on the rear panel was used to model it as dc-barrel; unit ships with an external DCR15/4AU DC supply. eth-1g grade on the Dante ports is inferred from a "1G" link-speed LED label visible on the rear panel photo, not from an explicit written spec line; the separate control-Ethernet RJ45 has no stated speed so its grade was omitted. Exact individual labels for the two Dante RJ45 jacks (e.g. Primary/Secondary) were not legible in the source image, so they are generically numbered Dante 1/Dante 2. Variants M2T/E01, M2T/E02, M2T/E06, and M2TND differ only in RF frequency band/power (e.g. /E06 supports up to 100mW EIRP), not in physical I/O.
